Release/tooling facts (Lively Eyes): - **MC skin cache:** MC 26.1 caches skins at `ModrinthApp/meta/assets/skins/<2 chars>/` and loads that file instead of downloading. Swap it for a local-only skin test (needs a game restart). - **Modrinth description images:** only allowlisted hosts load directly (cdn.modrinth.com, imgur, github…); others are proxied via wsrv.nl and often fail. Allowed: `

`, `` with width/style (`image-rendering: pixelated`), `
`, ``, YouTube iframes. - **Modrinth drafts:** invisible until moderation approves. - **Owner preferences:** - Emojis only in README headings. - The owner removes README sections on purpose; don't re-add them. - Talk to the owner in Korean. - **Hair sway idea (on hold until the owner brings it back):** do it in the bridge mod via `SkinLayersAPI.setupMeshTransformerProvider`. It is applied per render in `CustomizableModelPart.compile`, so you can offset hat-mesh vertices with per-player spring physics, weighted to the back/bottom. Open problems: which entity's hat is being compiled, and chaining with other providers. Rejected alternative: swinging the whole headwear part (moves bangs/hats; FA resets headwear rotation).
